<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><b>Exhibit 3.1</b></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-transform: uppercase">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-transform: uppercase"><b>SECOND AMENDMENT TO</b></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><font style="text-transform: uppercase"><b>Amended and Restated declaration of trust</b></font><br><font style="text-transform: uppercase"><b>of</b></font><br><font style="text-transform: uppercase"><b>SOUND POINT DIRECT LENDING BDC</b></font></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><b>July</b><b>&nbsp;</b><b>24, 2026</b></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><b>* * * * * * * * * *</b></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">WHEREAS, the initial Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust of Sound Point Direct Lending BDC (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) was entered into effective as of November&nbsp;17, 2025 and amended by the First Amendment to the Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust, which was effective as of March&nbsp;9, 2026 (as amended, the &#8220;Existing Declaration of Trust&#8221;), and capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meaning set forth in the Existing Declaration of Trust; and</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">WHEREAS, pursuant to <u>Section</u><u>&nbsp;</u><u>5.1</u> of the Existing Declaration of Trust, the Existing Declaration of Trust may be amended with the consent of the Board of Trustees;</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">WHEREAS, the Board of Trustees has approved this Second Amendment (the &#8220;Second Amendment&#8221;) to the Existing Declaration of Trust in accordance with the terms of the Existing Declaration of Trust;</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">NOW, THEREFORE, the Existing Declaration of Trust is hereby amended as follows:</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">1. <u>Amendment to Article XI</u>. ARTICLE XI of the Existing Declaration of Trust is hereby amended by adding Section&nbsp;11.8 as set forth below:</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">Section&nbsp;11.8 <u>Management Reports</u>. To the extent permitted under Japan&#8217;s Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended) (the &#8220;Japanese Regulation Act&#8221;), no investment management related information pursuant to Articles 59 and 14 of the Japanese Regulation Act shall be provided to shareholders.</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">2. Except as amended by this Second Amendment, the Existing Declaration of Trust remains in full force and effect.</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">3. This Second Amendment shall be effective as of the date first written above.</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><i>[Signature page follows]</i></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have caused this Second Amendment to be executed as of the day and year first above written.</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</p>
